title: label2patch
description: Utility to create patches from label files in Freesurfer.

dilate.description: Dilate the label n times before creating the patch
dilate.title: Dilate

erode.description: Erode the label n times before creating the patch
erode.title: Erode

close.description: Close the label n times before creating the patch
close.title: Close

subjects_dir.description: Use path as the SUBJECTS_DIR instead of environment
subjects_dir.title: Subjects Directory

write_surface.description: Write output to a surface file (not a patch). Use .stl in filename to only write the mesh covered by the label, saving it in FS format will save full surface
write_surface.title: Write Surface
